stance_rationale: REJECT and production BLOCKED are directionally correct: MDD, turnover, SR, DSR, AX-007, and AX-008 all fail. Conditional approval only: the judge draft overstates PIT/lockbox, Harvey/DSR, same-period baseline, cost-convention, and AX-008 evidence quality in places that should be downgraded before final publication.

scenario_rule_audit.replacement_evidence: request.json frames DPL as STR_1715 substitution or orthogonal sleeve candidate; judge correctly rejects before any sequential admission/TDC threshold can matter.

statistical_robustness_audit.point_estimate_vs_robust_tradeoff: DPL rejection is robust to point-estimate ambiguity because SR=-0.3396, MDD=65.45%, and DSR<0. However Harvey 5-spec is placeholder, DSR used n_trials=1, and STR_1715 same-period baseline is not recomputed, so these cannot support conclusive L-code root-cause claims beyond a v1.0 implementation failure.

critical_concerns.description: Gate0 PIT PASS is overclaimed. The user-specified qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_001 path is absent, lookahead_scan.json is design-time/self-authored, pit_audit still has C7 automated scan deferred and C11/FRED availability caveats, and Forge logs show 2024-2026 windows were used before judge seal. This does not overturn REJECT, but it should be INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE rather than PASS.

The draft rationalizes statistical gaps as non-load-bearing while still converting the cycle into an empirical L-328 lesson. Harvey 5-spec repeats one intercept-only Newey-West t-stat, DSR used n_trials=1 despite method-shopping evidence, and same-period STR_1715 comparison remains proxy/TBD.

Cost and turnover evidence is internally inconsistent. Judge Gate2 states 15bps x TO=17.64 implies 26.46% annual friction, Gate6 states 15bps x 2 x 17.64 = 5.29%, while forge_artifacts_builder.R actually subtracts 0.0015 x turnover. Turnover hard fail still stands, but cost-Pareto numerics need one unit convention.

Risk/optimizer rebuttal validation is incomplete. dpl_risk_attribution.json reports variance_explained_top_10=0.0439 and top_20=0.082, far below the risk-stage implicit-B target language, and optimizer comparison uses placeholder STR_1715/EW columns. Judge should explicitly mark these as additional failures instead of leaving rebuttal validation implicit.

AX-008 accounting is directionally blocking but phrased too strongly. Forge FAIL plus Codex REJECT is enough to block admission, but Architect='deferred' is not an independent third-source FAIL, so '3-source converge' and '0/3' should be rewritten as 'no 2-source PASS possible'.

supporting_arguments: weights.csv and alpha_scores.parquet exist in stage_artifacts/WT_D20260517_001 with 51 sig_dates, not a single snapshot; each date has 20 nonzero names, long-only weights, max weight 0.05, and sum_w approximately 1.
Selected names pass liquidity in the available liq_panel: min selected ADV20 is 201,593,961 KRW and there are no selected-name admin/halt/unfaithful flags.
covariance.parquet is PSD in the checked stage artifact: 51 dates, 20x20 per date, min eigenvalue positive, max condition number 27.5962, so the user-requested cond<=100 check passes for dir B.

Core REJECT evidence is strong: SR=-0.3396, MDD=65.45%, CAGR=-9.34%, DSR_Z=-2.2682, annualized turnover=17.64 versus 6.0 cap, and all nonzero weights are effectively equal-weight 0.05, invalidating AX-007 ML-sizing exemption.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: I agree with the REJECT direction, not with every evidentiary label. Forge FAIL plus Codex REJECT blocks admission, but Architect deferred and placeholder statistical artifacts should not be counted as completed triangulation.
